fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. Jeremiah is the one telling it, and he says, “Then, as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard…” (Jeremiah 32:8). The LORD said he would come, and he came, right to the locked-up prophet. Jeremiah says that's when he knew this was the word of the LORD.

SHILOH! Okay, baker, I see you reaching for a big Bible name, and I respect the confidence. But Hanamel's offer in verse 7 is for his field in Anathoth, and verse 8 puts it in the land of Benjamin. Shiloh never shows up in these verses, not even to wave. Anathoth is the name to tuck in your apron.
